description: This file contains functions and types related to fetching and caching message history and thread replies from a specific API, including formatting IDs and managing message cache.

methods.name: formatUd
methods.description: Formats a number or string as @ud with dots every 3 digits from the right.

methods.name: cacheMessage
methods.description: Caches a message in the messageCache map for a specific channel.

methods.name: fetchChannelHistory
methods.description: Fetches message history for a channel from the API, with error handling and data parsing.

methods.name: getChannelHistory
methods.description: Returns cached messages if available, otherwise fetches from API.

methods.name: fetchThreadHistory
methods.description: Fetches reply thread history for a specific post, with fallback to alternate path if initial fetch fails.
